selection_rule.ranking: descending raw_ev, then descending shape_edge_ratio, then descending q, then market, then ticket key

why_not_tuned_on_C: The 0.40 competition threshold was frozen before Segment C.
P00-equivalent EV>=0 and shape-ratio>=1, SINGLE, and FK10_R2 are inherited from the prior frozen Stage7 family rather than optimized against Segment C outcomes.
No C ROI or selected-ticket ledger was used to choose these values.

final_holdout_acceptance.calibration_primary: B1a_MKT50 ticket log loss must remain strictly lower than raw B1a on ECON_HOLDOUT1000.
final_holdout_acceptance.tail_calibration: >=300x calibration error must improve; zero realized tail hits is INCONCLUSIVE.
final_holdout_acceptance.economic_roi_gate: ROI must be >= 0 only when realized hit count >= 20; otherwise economic evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.
final_holdout_acceptance.profit_concentration_gate: largest single positive-return event must be <= 50% of gross return.
final_holdout_acceptance.promotion_rule: Calibration gates must pass and economic gates must pass; ROI cannot rescue failed calibration.

prohibited: Do not alter pool weight 0.50 after holdout open.
Do not alter competition_score threshold 0.40 after holdout open.
Do not alter eligibility thresholds, SINGLE template, or FK10_R2 after holdout open.
Do not reuse Segment C to select alternative rules.
Do not claim profitability before ECON_HOLDOUT1000 evidence exists.
